label: .liveAngleCommits
find: if let draft = cropDraft(angle: degrees) { cropDraft = draft }

label: .liveAngleLeavesCatalog
find: guard degrees.isFinite, let draft = cropDraft, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }
replace: guard let draft = cropDraft, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }

label: .liveDragFromShown
find: return (try? services.crop.dragged(draft, handle: handle, dx: dx, dy: dy, photo: size)) ?? draft
replace: return (try? services.crop.dragged(cropDraft ?? draft, handle: handle, dx: dx, dy: dy, photo: size)) ?? draft
